notes:
I couldn't write these notes, because I wasn't able to read any of the sources.

My first attempt asked for seven pages at once: Enduring Word, Ellicott, Gill, the Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin, Benson and Matthew Henry on Ezekiel 25. It failed straight away with a "tool use limit exceeded" error. When I tried to fetch just the Enduring Word page, the system said I had no tool calls left for this turn. So I haven't opened a single page.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point, and never to fill gaps from memory. Writing a commentary from what I already know would break those rules, so I've left it blank rather than give you notes with no real sources behind them.

If you ask again in a new message, my tools should be available again. I'd read the pages one or two at a time so I don't hit the limit, in this order:
1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word's chapter on Ezekiel 25, then the Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit and Matthew Henry pages on biblehub.com, then Precept Austin.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** search the denominational sites for Ezekiel 25, especially v. 14 ("by the hand of My people Israel"), where readings of Israel's role may vary. That's my guess at the likeliest point of difference, not something I found.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes (netbible.org) on things like "people of the East," the Cherethites and Teman to Dedan, plus anything on Bible Odyssey, New Advent or OCA about the oracles against the nations.

If you'd rather go faster, you could paste in the text of the pages you trust most and I'll write the notes from those.
